'''Begali''' was a celestial body<ref name="Author's Cut" /> located in the [[Begali system/Legends|Begali system]] of the [[Inner Rim/Legends|Inner Rim]].<ref name="EAOC" /> By [[1154 BBY]], Begali was affiliated with the [[Six Sisters]], a group of [[Planet/Legends|worlds]] governed by the confederation known as the [[Echani Command]]. That [[Standard year/Legends|year]], Begali launched a rebellion,<ref name="Author's Cut" /> known as the [[Begali Uprising]],<ref name="IS2">[[Imperial Sourcebook (Second Edition)|''Imperial Sourcebook'', Second Edition]]</ref> against the Six Sisters, severing its ties with one of them, [[Eshan/Legends|Eshan]], and allying itself with the world [[Thyrsus/Legends|Thyrsus]]. Less than a [[Standard century/Legends|century]] later, however, Begali renewed its ties with Eshan, although Thyrsus remained independent of the Echani Command.<ref name="Author's Cut" />

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:Grehollo-Voyages13.png|thumb|right|250px|Map placement of Begali in ''Voyages SF'' 13]]
The name "Begali" was introduced via a mention of the Begali Uprising in [[Greg Gorden]]'s [[1989]] ''[[Imperial Sourcebook]]'' that was published by [[West End Games]] for use with ''[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game]]''.<ref name="ISB">''[[Imperial Sourcebook]]''</ref> "[[Twinkle, Twinkle Little Star, How I Wonder Where We Are]]," a [[1990]] [[roleplaying game]] source article published in the [[Voyages SF 13|thirteenth issue]] of the ''[[Voyages SF]]'' magazine subsequently described Begali as a distinct celestial body. Since that article was released outside of the [[Lucas Licensing]] process,<ref name="Twinkle">{{VoyagesCite|13|Twinkle, Twinkle Little Star, How I Wonder Where We Are}}</ref> it was considered non-[[canon]]ical with respect to the [[Star Wars Legends|''Star Wars'' Legends]] continuity.<ref name="UnlicensedStatus">{{UnlicensedStatus}}</ref>

"Twinkle, Twinkle Little Star, How I Wonder Where We Are" placed Begali, as well as the [[Columus system/Legends|Columus]], [[Grehollo system/Legends|Grehollo]], [[Jedd system/Legends|Jedd]], [[Jerijador system/Legends|Jerijador]], [[Kaelta system|Kaelta]], [[Nosken system/Legends|Nosken]], and [[Tsukkia system/Legends|Tsukkia system]], in the [[Grehollo sector]].<ref name="Twinkle" /> The [[StarWars.com]] [[Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion|Online Companion]] to the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' has since instead placed the Grehollo, Jerijador, Kaelta, Nosken, and Tsukkia [[Star system/Legends|systems]] in other [[Sector/Legends|sectors]]. Furthermore, since the Online Companion has also placed the Begali, Columus, and Jedd systems each in a different [[The galaxy/Legends|galactic]] region&mdash;with the Begali system being situated in grid square M-8&mdash;this article assumes the ''Voyages SF'' 13 placement is no longer applicable to any of the systems listed here.<ref name="EAOC" />

A section was created for the [[2012]] reference book ''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]'', authored by [[Jason Fry]] and [[Paul R. Urquhart]], which would have provided the first canonical description of Begali as a distinct astronomical object in ''Star Wars'' Legends. Although the section was cut from the book, it was later released in [[2013]] as part of [[Star Wars: The Essential Guide to Warfare Author's Cut|''Star Wars: The Essential Guide to Warfare'' Author's Cut]], a series of articles published on the StarWars.com [[Star Wars Blog|Blog]] by Fry and<ref name="Author's Cut" /> [[Del Rey]] editor<ref name="Celestials">{{SW|url=news/star-wars-the-essential-guide-to-warfare-authors-cut-the-celestials|text=''Star Wars: The Essential Guide to Warfare'' Author's Cut &mdash; The Celestials|int=Star Wars: The Essential Guide to Warfare Author's Cut}}</ref> [[Erich Schoeneweiss]] containing various cut content from the book.<ref name="Author's Cut" />
